caption: The drawing shows two wooden objects with X-shaped frames mounted on top of oval, flat bases. The wood is rendered with light brown and beige tones, and there are visible nails or rivets along the arms of each X. Each X-shaped frame is reinforced with horizontal wraps that appear to be rope or twine, colored a muted yellow. Both bases are positioned parallel to each other and are connected by a strap system: two leather straps in a medium brown color, each with a metal buckle, loop through and around the wooden structures, one strap lying flat in the foreground. The background is a plain, light beige color with slight discolorations and stains, and there are no other objects or features in the background. The artist’s signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Pack Saddle
